about: The plan of the lab for the dashboard (tools/auto-analysis/lab_dash.py). The manager keeps it current with each decision. The decisions stay in gap-program.md, the results in README.md (journal). Impact scale 0 to 10: 0 = no effect; 1-2 = inside the noise or a small fact; 3-4 = a clear gain on one measure; 5-6 = a clear gain on a main measure, or it unblocks a stream; 7-8 = a large gain on a main measure, or it unblocks a milestone; 9-10 = it decides a milestone. 'expectedBackfilled' = the expected impact was written after the result (the actions before the dashboard had no number). Each open action has 'doneWhen': the results that can be checked objectively (a count, a file, a journal row, a label status), with the place to check them (the user, 2026-11-27).

issues.title: Points with no row (double faults, short points)
issues.detail: 9 labeled points have no rally row, and 5 second serves of a double fault are outside the rows (E173). The rally GRU is below the threshold in 6 of 7 (E169). A double fault has no rally, so the GRU is the wrong detector; the serve-event rule finds 1 of 36 (E190), limited by M2-I3.

issues.detail: 13 missed hits are first-serve faults, 6 of them have a fault clip (E173). Fault clips find 4 of 11 labeled faults (E170); held out 72 of 121 marked faults. The true precision of the fault clips waits for the Faults step (27 rows).

issues.title: Serve event recall
issues.detail: 17 of 24 labeled fault serves have a serve event (E190). The far serve events at a + 2.5 s: about 198 of 291 lab far starts (E154). This limits M2-I1 and M2-I2.

issues.title: False events after the point
issues.detail: case_history now reports them apart (E139 a). Bounces after the point on the fragments 94 to 69 with BOUNCE_GROUND_UP (E183). They can change the last shot and the winner (m1021 6623).

issues.title: Shot count and missed hits inside the rows
issues.detail: Inside the rows: time error over 0.3 s 8, unusable flight 5, chain rule 5, track gap 4, no shot 3, hitter 2 (E173). The shot chain is not the main gap.

issues.title: Too few labels for the event measures
issues.detail: 16 of 59 fragments labeled (small level first, then 4 medium). The Faults step (27 rows) and the Sides step (5 matches) are not done. Counts are small, so most results are 'inside the noise'.

issues.title: Court stage slow on Misha
issues.detail: Court 2835 s on Misha against 267 s on Igor (E103). A speed item for the app.

issues.title: m1030 is the weakest lab match

issues.title: Serve in/out judged on the full court, not the service box
issues.detail: A serve that lands behind the service line or in the wrong box is 'in' for the shot chain. Seen in E76 (Igor double fault, wrong winner), E170 (2 of 54 in/out errors), E171 (e), E190 (s007 1891.1). Only the fault candidate tests the service line (E39).
